```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(rvest)

```

## strings and regex

```{r}
string_vec = c("my", "name", "is", "jeff")

str_detect(string_vec, "jeff")
str_detect(string_vec, "My")
str_detect(string_vec, "my")

str_replace(string_vec, "my", "My")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "i think we all rule for participating",
  "i think i have been caught",
  "i think this will be quite fun actually",
  "it will be fun, i think"
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "i think")
str_detect(string_vec, "^i think")
str_detect(string_vec, "i think$")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  "Time for a Pumpkin Spice Latte!",
  "went to the #pumpkinpatch last weekend",
  "Pumpkin Pie is obviously the best pie",
  "SMASHING PUMPKINS -- LIVE IN CONCERT!!"
  )

str_detect(string_vec,"[Pp]umpkin")
```


```{r}
string_vec = c(
  '7th inning stretch',
  '1st half soon to begin. Texas won the toss.',
  'she is 5 feet 4 inches tall',
  '3AM - cant sleep :('
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "^[0-9][a-zA-Z]")
```


```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'Its 7:11 in the evening',
  'want to go to 7-11?',
  'my flight is AA711',
  'NetBios: scanning ip 203.167.114.66'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "7.11")
```

```{r}
string_vec = c(
  'The CI is [2, 5]',
  ':-]',
  ':-[',
  'I found the answer on pages [6-7]'
  )

str_detect(string_vec, "\\[")
```

##quick note on factors

```{r}
vec_sex = factor(c("male", "male", "female", "female"))
as.numeric(vec_sex)   # 2 2 1 1  (levels are alphabetical: female = 1, male = 2)

vec_sex = fct_relevel(vec_sex, "male")

as.numeric(vec_sex)   # 1 1 2 2  (male is now the first level)
```

```{r}
nsduh_url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"
```

```{r}
table_marj = 
  read_html(nsduh_url) |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |>
  slice(-1) |>
  select(-contains("P Value")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -State,
    names_to = "age_year",
    values_to = "prev"
  ) |>
  separate(age_year, into = c("{age", "year"), sep = "\\(") |>
  mutate(
    year = str_replace(year, "\\)", ""),
    prev = str_replace(prev, "[a-c]", ""),
    prev = as.numeric(prev)
  )
```


make a quick plot

```{r}
data_marj |>
  filter(age == "12-17") |> 
  mutate(State = fct_reorder(State, prev)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = State, y = prev, color = year)) + 
    geom_point() + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
